facts.claim: The government organized a regular establishment for public works in Coorg in 1862.
facts.quote: It was not until the year 1862, that the wants of Coorg were suflficiently recognised, to induce Government to organize a regular establishment for the execution of Public Works in Coorg.

facts.claim: Sappers and Miners carried out public works in Coorg since 1834, and after they left an European Overseer took charge of the roads.
facts.quote: A detachment of Sappers and Miners having been stationed in the Province since 1834, all the needful Public Works were carried out by them and after they had been withdrawn, an European Overseer took charge of the roads etc.

facts.claim: Coorg has two trunk roads intersecting at Mercara and a branch road near Vlrdjpet connecting the western and eastern highroads.
facts.quote: Coorg is crossed by two trunk-roads from east to west and from north to south, intersecting each other at Mercara, and by a branch-road near Vlrdjpet the western and eastern highroads are connected.
